name: first_contact_no_email_standard_dispute
use_case: Pick up a case that started by email and continue it with the banking tools
branch: Customer raises the Shell Oil charge TX04 in chat with no email about it (his only emails are about a card replacement); the assistant completes the case with the banking tools without inventing an email about the charge.
